name: wf-handoff
description: Hands a long chat off on its own at the token line: /rollover, clear, resume (spec 0063); /handoff by hand after /rollover (spec 0057)

threshold.title: Handoff line (tokens)
threshold.description: Context size at which the chat hands itself off; AUTO_HANDOFF_TOKENS overrides it for one shell

minHeadroom.title: Headroom after a handoff (tokens)
minHeadroom.description: A chat that came from a handoff grows at least this much past its starting size before it hands off again

maxConsecutiveHandoffs.title: Handoffs in a row
maxConsecutiveHandoffs.description: Handoffs with no message from you before it pauses until you type

sectionsTemplate.title: Sections template
sectionsTemplate.description: File whose text is handed to /rollover; blank means ~/.claude/auto-handoff/sections.md

instructionsTemplate.title: Instructions template
instructionsTemplate.description: File whose text is handed to /resume-from-clear; blank means ~/.claude/auto-handoff/instructions.md

ignoreFiles.title: Ignored files
ignoreFiles.description: Comma separated globs left out of the files list in the handover

viewer.title: Viewer address
viewer.description: [host:]port of the handover pages (host tailscale or an IP); blank for no server (spec 0064)
